subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers keep this contributor PR as the landing path by asking for a rebase and real two-profile proof, or adopt the fix on a clean replacement branch?
rationale: The branch is conflicting and proof-gated, and automation cannot supply the contributor's real Copilot credential-rotation proof or decide whether to adopt a stale external PR.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor port the guard to src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, update current tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a clean replacement
options.body: A maintainer can open a narrow replacement PR against current main if the bug is urgent or the contributor branch remains conflicted.

options.title: Pause or close after no response
options.body: If no rebase or proof arrives after maintainer follow-up, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor port the guard to src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts, update current tests, and add redacted real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and has recent history on the active provider-auth/token helper.
